articles.title: Taylor Swift’s Toy Story 5 Song Breaks a World Record!
articles.summary: Imagine a song so catchy that 51.5 million people streamed it in just one week! Taylor Swift’s new single from Toy Story 5 just hit No. 1 on a global chart, making her the solo artist with the most chart-toppers.

articles.title: Giant Wooden Prints Tell a Family’s Story of Leaving Home
articles.summary: What if your family had to flee in the night, carrying only what they could hold? Artist Annalise Gratovich carves life-size wooden figures filled with flowers, birds, and Ukrainian patterns to explore her family’s escape during World War II.

articles.title: Tokyo Hosts a Huge Music Party—and Makes History!
articles.summary: For the first time ever, the Billboard Global Power Players awards landed in Asia! Tokyo threw a star-studded ceremony honoring music bosses who help your favorite artists travel the world. A Japanese dancer even said one winner “changed my life.”
